name: bentOS — This Portfolio
shortDescription: The site you're on. A Next.js + Three.js portfolio with a 3D viewer, Matter.js BentoGrid, grounded chat assistant, and a boot-screen OS theme.
description: bentOS is Kevin's personal portfolio, built as an interactive OS-themed surface rather than a static resume. Features include a boot splash gate, a procedural 3D cat in a Three.js viewer with LOD and FPS-aware perf, an infinite Matter.js-driven BentoGrid for /projects and /playground, a Gemini-backed chat assistant that only answers from grounded portfolio content, eight playable mini-games, and a long-form /scrollable view with a globe of life locations. Strict TypeScript, Tailwind CSS variables for theming, Vitest + Playwright tests, Lighthouse CI, and bundle-size budgets enforced on every PR. Content (projects, photos, talking points) is file-based JSON and rebuilt automatically by an update-portfolio agent skill.
